instruction: GUI-only requirement: Complete the task entirely in the launched OpenStudio Application graphical user interface. Do not open Terminal or a shell; do not run Ruby, Python, OpenStudio CLI, EnergyPlus command-line tools, shell commands, or helper scripts; do not edit OSM, OSW, SQL, ERR, or other deliverable files directly outside the GUI. Use only OpenStudio Application GUI tools, dialogs, and built-in save/run commands. Shaded Window Simulation. Work in the opened OpenStudio application, starting from the Desktop input file init.osm. Modify the model rather than replacing the task package with an unrelated file. Save result.osm in the task output folder. Starting from init.osm and weather.epw, add one south-facing FixedWindow, one exterior overhang shading surface, internal loads, a thermostat, and ideal loads, then run the simulation from the OpenStudio GUI. The completed model must contain 1 building story, 1 spaces and 1 thermal zones. Use these exact OS:Space names: ShadedOffice. Every space must be assigned to a building story and a thermal zone, and each space must have more than 0.05 m2 of floor area. Model the enclosure with 6 OS:Surface objects, split into 1 floor surfaces, 1 roof/ceiling surfaces and 4 wall surfaces. The surface outside-boundary counts should be 1 Ground, 5 Outdoors and 0 Surface. Add 1 OS:SubSurface objects, all FixedWindow windows, with total fixed-window area 6.00 m2 within +/-0.75 m2. Include 1 ideal-loads air systems, 1 zone HVAC equipment lists and 1 dual-setpoint thermostats. Include simple metadata objects for schedules and loads: at least 3 schedule rulesets, 1 people loads, 1 lights loads, 1 electric equipment loads and 0 space type objects. Add 1 exterior shading surface with total shading area 4.00 m2 within +/-0.75 m2. Set the geometry so the overall surface-geometry bounding box spans 10.00 m in X, 6.00 m in Y and 3.20 m in Z, each within +/-0.10 m. The total floor surface area should be 60.00 m2 within +/-0.75 m2 and the total exterior wall gross area should be 102.40 m2 within +/-0.75 m2.  Use the uploaded weather.epw in the OpenStudio GUI if the model asks for a weather file. After saving result.osm, run the simulation from the OpenStudio Application GUI and leave the natural run output folder in the task output location. The evaluator will check result.osm plus run/eplusout.sql and run/eplusout.err; do not create custom KPI or CSV files. Other model details may vary as long as the saved OSM and simulation outputs satisfy these stated requirements.
